votes.question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Concur in the Senate Amendments — AGOA Extension Act (H R 6500)
votes.bill_title: Continuing Appropriations and Extensions Act, 2027
votes.plain_language: The House voted to accept the Senate's rewrite of this bill, which became a stopgap that funds federal agencies into fiscal year 2027, generally through December 11, 2026, and extends several expiring programs. It is not a vote on the bill's original Africa-trade text. A two-thirds Yea accepts the Senate version; a Nay rejects it.

votes.plain_language: This resolution sets federal budget targets for fiscal year 2027 through 2036 and instructs several House committees to write bills that would raise the deficit by limited amounts, which can move under faster reconciliation rules. funding.detail: Federal cards show the principal campaign committee and OpenFEC totals for one two-year cycle, plus itemized Schedule A contributors. House uses 2026. Senate uses the cycle of the next election (2026, 2028, or 2030). This is not career fundraising and does not include Schedule E outside spending. Governors do not get a federal contribution list.
